description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'Smarty_Resource_Recompiled' which serves as a base for resource plugins in the Smarty templating engine that handle recompiled resources without caching. It includes methods for processing templates, populating compiled file paths, and timestamp checks.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Recompiled
classes.description: An abstract base class for Smarty resource plugins that handle recompiled templates without cache, providing methods to process templates and manage compiled file paths.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the given Smarty template to compile it, handling exceptions and cleaning output buffer.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Sets the compiled file path and timestamp to false, indicating no physical compiled file.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Returns false, disabling timestamp checks for recompiled resources.
